source_caption:
The “One way out” speech in Andor was filmed with Andy Serkis delivering it repeatedly at full intensity, building real exhaustion and urgency on set. Director Tony Gilroy wanted the moment to feel like a genuine breaking point, turning a simple line into one of the most powerful speeches in Star Wars.

Andor (2022– ), created by Tony Gilroy, starring Diego Luna, Stellan Skarsgård, Denise Gough. A grounded and intensely political Star Wars thriller that strips away myth to explore rebellion, sacrifice, and the slow, painful birth of resistance through realism and moral tension.
